label: nyiso 92 hydro envelope
definition: (KEEPER) nyiso-92 single mechanism-family delta on the nyiso-89 keeper: hydro_dispatch_envelope + hydro_min_flow_floor — the measured two-sided EIA-930 NG:WAT hydro capability envelope (caiso-72/124 keeper engines; NYISO levels derive from NYISO's own series at solve time; the one percentile is the pre-existing cross-ISO constant, ZERO new fitted scalars, n_residual unchanged at 6). Eliminates the hydro parks-at-zero pathology (hours <100 MW 349/405/1098 -> 0/0/0; hourly p5 274/151/0 -> 2100/1852/1376 MW vs measured 2072/1969/1526; day-to-day std 20.9/23.4/22.8 -> 8.4/11.3/11.5 GWh vs measured 6.2/8.4/7.9) and lifts EVERY material gas class's hourly r in EVERY year (TOTAL fossil 0.861/0.836/0.788 -> 0.915/0.896/0.819; CC_REGULAR 0.705/0.583/0.536 -> 0.770/0.652/0.573), plus imports r_hr 0.477/0.493/0.396 -> 0.587/0.612/0.454 untouched by any seam change. PROMOTED WITH A GATE REGRESSION ON THE RECORD (owner standing rule 2026-07-28): C1 2023 CC_REGULAR -2.784 -> -3.045 TWh of ±2.94 now FAILS by 0.105 TWh (13/14, free 9/10) — the control's PASS was borrowing ~0.26 TWh of phantom overnight CC that existed only because hydro could park at 0 MW; the accurate input reveals the true downstate CC deficit (rule 14, never grounds to restore false structure). C3c UNCHANGED 3/0/7 h vs 10/12/42 and remains the sole determination blocker (the measured tail is SUMMER RT scarcity — Jun 23-25 2025 alone is 18 h; DA-virtual-depth lane, matrix N=U). C8 2024 ST_GAS improves 32.0% -> 30.9% forced (grounded). C6 PASS (UNION'd DOF ledger, 20 entries / 6 residual). Honest adverse cells: CT_PEAKER 2024 r_day 0.735 -> 0.668; C7 CT_PEAKER 2025 cv_ratio 0.934 -> 0.797 (both ungated, class under the 2% floor). LOYO: no parameter fitted to any year (each year's bounds from that year's own measured series). DETERMINATION NOT-YET — same class and same sole blocker as the nyiso-89 keeper it replaces. Write-up: docs/FINDING-nyiso92-hydro-capability-envelope-2026-07-28.md; log: docs/calibration-log/nyiso.md 2026-07-28 nyiso-92.
market_story: Conventional hydro: NYISO's fleet is 72%-by-MW two run-of-river NYPA projects (Robert Moses Niagara, treaty-scheduled scenic flows; Robert Moses St-Lawrence, IJC Plan 2014 releases) plus small licensed projects — inflow and licence minimum releases run around the clock, so the real fleet NEVER parks at zero (measured hourly p5 1.5-2.1 GW) and cannot hoard a month's water into the top price hours (measured day-to-day std 6-8 GWh). The measured p95 month×hod ceiling and its mirrored Q95 monthly floor are that physical capability window; the LP dispatches economically inside it. Gas classes: with overnight hydro restored to its real sustained level, the phantom overnight CC dispatch that filled the model's hydro hole disappears and evening peaks that hoarded hydro used to serve return to ST_GAS/CT — which is why every gas class's hour-by-hour tracking against CAMPD improves while total energy moves <0.1%.
